wine_name: Terroir Al Limit Les Tosses, Catalunya

hook.note: Vine age inflated (ground truth says 90-year-old, not 100); producer name incorrectly given as 'Domaine de la Terre Rouge' instead of 'Terroir Al Limit'; 'carbonic maceration' is not confirmed—ground truth says whole cluster native fermentation, not carbonic; 'silkiness' borderline but not banned.

wine_summary.note: Accurately describes the philosophy and founding partnership (Sadie/Huber), but 'north-facing slope' is fabricated—not in ground truth; overall narrative is solid and direct.

terroir_expression.note: 'North-facing aspect' is fabricated; llicorella description and 600m elevation concept are correct; 'continental-Mediterranean climate' is reasonable but not sourced; strong voice with specific geological language.

vinification_summary.note: Describes carbonic maceration, but ground truth says whole cluster native fermentation with two weeks on skins—not the same; says 'large, neutral oak foudres' for 8 months, but ground truth for recent vintages says cement tanks, not oak; multiple factual errors.

food_pairing.note: Pairings are plausible and well-reasoned for old-vine Carignan from Priorat; no factual errors per se; direct and specific.

comparable_wines.note: Clos Erasmus comparison is reasonable; Matassa is a good comp but 'carbonic maceration philosophy' may not be fully accurate for Les Tosses; Thymiopoulos is a creative and defensible pick; direct voice.

style_profile.note: Reasonable but very brief; 'silky tannins' is plausible given whole-cluster approach; could be more specific and opinionated.

cellar_recommendation.note: 5-8 years is reasonable; 55°F storage is standard; no fabricated numbers but no ground truth to confirm aging window precisely.

value_assessment.note: Price range is plausible but not verified in context; comparison to L'Ermita is a stretch as L'Ermita is far more expensive; 'centenarian' overstates vine age (90 years per ground truth); direct and opinionated voice.

market_position.note: Reasonable positioning; no major factual errors; direct and specific about target audience.

insider_take.note: Accurate characterization of the wine's style vs. traditional Priorat; takes a clear position; no banned words; strong voice.

overall_note: Generally strong voice throughout with no banned words, but several factual errors: vine age inflated, wrong producer name in hook, carbonic maceration asserted without basis, cement tanks misidentified as oak foudres, and fabricated vineyard orientation details.
